proposed_results.relation_rationale: Select the joint six-arm Bayesian mITT without postrescue Result at 26 weeks, directly matching the requested outcome, time and all eight LY3298176-versus-placebo/dulaglutide contrasts. The saved group-bound form retains all six reported posterior means; the article's reported posterior mean differences (80% credible sets), in dose order 1/5/10/15 mg, are versus placebo: -1∙00% [-1∙22 to -0∙79], -1∙67% [-1∙88 to -1∙46], -1∙83% [-2∙04 to -1∙61], -1∙89% [-2∙11 to -1∙67]; versus dulaglutide: 0∙15% (-0∙08 to 0∙38), -0∙52% (-0∙72 to -0∙31), -0∙67% (-0∙89 to -0∙46), -0∙73% (-0∙95 to -0∙52) (main article pages 1 and 6). Source % values describe absolute HbA1c concentration changes/differences, not relative percentage reduction. Scope is narrower than the tool's all-randomized assignment target because of mITT exclusions and removal of postrescue data, although it matches the researcher's requested mITT report. It is not an unrestricted ITT treatment-policy effect. Bayesian mITT on-treatment and MMRM mITT on-treatment are competing analysis candidates with different numerical values and discontinuation handling; 12-week and HbA1c-threshold endpoints differ in time or outcome. The supplement explicitly identifies the selected dataset and confirms the main-article means. The article and embedded protocol designate 26-week HbA1c change as primary; the protocol treats Bayesian comparison with dulaglutide as secondary. A blanket absence of designated primary outcome is unsupported by these inspected Sources. Historical registry primary designation and timely final SAP availability are unverified. The registry version holder dated 2026-10-05 is current augmentation, not replayed historical registry bytes.

reported.analysis_population: Reported Bayesian mITT without postrescue dataset: all participants taking at least one study-drug dose and with at least one postbaseline measurement of any outcome (316 of 318 randomized; one untreated participant in each of the 1 mg and 10 mg groups excluded). Includes data irrespective of adherence and after treatment discontinuation, excludes efficacy data after rescue initiation. Missing HbA1c responses imputed by longitudinal integrated two-component prediction model, with titration model for 10 and 15 mg. LY3298176/placebo fitted by hierarchical logistic dose-response model; dulaglutide independently modeled. mITT arm totals are 52,55,51,53,51,54 for LY1,LY5,LY10,LY15,placebo,DU; these are not established week-26 observed counts.
